title: Synology NAS
description: A shared folder on your Synology DiskStation, through DSM's WebDAV Server.
hints: In DSM, open Package Center and install WebDAV Server, then turn on HTTPS (port 5006). Port 5005 is plain http: EdgeSlicer allows it on your local network only, and warns you first.
The address is your NAS's name or IP address, the port, and the shared folder: https://diskstation.local:5006/models/ or https://192.168.1.20:5006/models/.
Sign in with a DSM user that can only read your models folder, not your admin account.
QuickConnect relay addresses do not work for WebDAV. From outside your home, use your own domain with HTTPS or a VPN such as Tailscale.
